## Objective
- Build a complete, playable drawing-themed 3D VR sandbox game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Ink physics: blue glass shatters, green leaf tears, black Floatstone cannot be converted, and purple Gravstone has gravity.
- Convert drawings into weapons, animals, or vehicles; support weapon parts and presets, animal rigging/hostility, and manual vehicle components.
- Provide VR, camera controls, haptics, hand tracking, and player-controlled settings, with graceful fallback where unsupported.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based Three.js game with locally bundled Three.js modules and fonts.
- Use “LINEBORN” branding, a four-ink palette, sketch trials, conversion UI, settings/help controls, and a VR entry button.
- Degrade VR, hand tracking, and haptics gracefully when browser or device support is unavailable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive HUD, local assets, scene/gameplay, drawing/conversion/builds, ink physics, controls, settings/help, and optional WebXR integration.
- Fixed the syntax error in `js/main.js`; `node --check js/main.js` now passes.
- Smoke-tested in headless Chromium: page loaded, WebGL canvas and six trials initialized, settings and help modals opened, and no JavaScript exceptions were observed.
- Captured and inspected the latest small JPEG screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/lineborn-latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate detailed gameplay interactions and address any issues found.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Exercise drawing, selection/conversion, tuning, ink physics, weapon fire/reload, vehicles, and VR capability fallback; fix issues found.
2. Investigate the lone browser console resource 404 if it persists or affects functionality.
3. Report assumptions and verification results; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell and DOM IDs.
- `styles.css`: HUD, dialogs, and responsive styling.
- `js/main.js`: Scene, gameplay, conversions, controls, and WebXR integration.
- `lib/`: Locally bundled Three.js modules and geometry utilities.
- `fonts/`: Local Caveat and Nunito font assets.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.

## Important Context
- Browser smoke test used local HTTP server on port `8765`; console showed one `404 (File not found)` resource warning but no JavaScript exceptions.
- VR and hand tracking depend on browser/device WebXR support; haptics require exposed controller actuators.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable drawing-themed 3D VR sandbox game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Ink physics: blue glass shatters, green leaf tears, black Floatstone cannot be converted, and purple Gravstone has gravity.
- Convert drawings into weapons, animals, or vehicles; support weapon parts and presets, animal rigging/hostility, and manual vehicle components.
- Provide VR, camera controls, haptics, hand tracking, and player-controlled settings, with graceful fallback where unsupported.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based Three.js game with locally bundled Three.js modules and fonts.
- Use “LINEBORN” branding, a four-ink palette, sketch trials, conversion UI, settings/help controls, and a VR entry button.
- Degrade VR, hand tracking, and haptics gracefully when browser or device support is unavailable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive HUD, local assets, scene/gameplay, drawing/conversion/builds, ink physics, controls, settings/help, and optional WebXR integration.
- Fixed the syntax error in `js/main.js`; `node --check js/main.js` passes.
- Smoke-tested with headless Chromium: page loaded, WebGL canvas and six trials initialized, settings/help modals opened, and no JavaScript exceptions observed during that check.
- Tested VR fallback: without a headset, the game reports “No immersive VR headset was detected.”
- Identified the 404 as `http://127.0.0.1:8765/favicon.ico`; no other failed URL was reported by the latest network check.
- Captured the latest screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/lineborn-latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate gameplay interactions and fix any issues found. Latest attempted pointer-drawing check did not draw or select an object (`score: 0`, selection hidden), so conversion, weapon tuning/fire/reload, and ink physics remain unverified.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Diagnose why the browser interaction check did not draw/select (script: `/tmp/opencode/gameplay-check.mjs`); rerun with corrected pointer events and validated canvas coordinates.
2. Exercise selection/conversion, weapon fire/reload, vehicle controls, and ink physics; fix any issues found.
3. Optionally add a local favicon or otherwise resolve the harmless `/favicon.ico` 404.
4. Report assumptions and verification results; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell and DOM IDs.
- `styles.css`: HUD, dialogs, and responsive styling.
- `js/main.js`: Scene, gameplay, conversions, controls, and WebXR integration.
- `lib/`: Locally bundled Three.js modules and geometry utilities.
- `fonts/`: Local Caveat and Nunito font assets.
- `start.sh`: Project startup script.
- `capture.sh`: Screenshot capture script.
- `/tmp/opencode/gameplay-check.mjs`: Latest browser interaction test; drawing gesture currently fails.

- Build a complete, playable drawing-themed 3D VR sandbox game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- Ink physics: blue glass shatters, green leaf tears, black Floatstone cannot be converted, and purple Gravstone has gravity.
- Convert drawings into weapons, animals, or vehicles; support weapon parts and presets, animal rigging/hostility, and manual vehicle components.
- Provide VR, camera controls, haptics, hand tracking, and player-controlled settings, with graceful fallback where unsupported.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based Three.js game with locally bundled Three.js modules and fonts.
- Use “LINEBORN” branding, a four-ink palette, sketch trials, conversion UI, settings/help controls, and a VR entry button.
- Degrade VR, hand tracking, and haptics gracefully when browser or device support is unavailable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the game shell, responsive HUD, local assets, scene/gameplay, drawing/conversion/builds, ink physics, controls, settings/help, and optional WebXR integration.
- Fixed the loader dismissal class in `js/main.js` to match `.gone` in `styles.css`; added `favicon.svg` and linked it in `index.html`.
- Diagnosed drawing hit-testing: `#hud > * { pointer-events:auto }` overrode the cursor’s lower-specificity pointer-events rule. Added `#hud > .brush-cursor{pointer-events:none}` in `styles.css`.
- Confirmed Floatstone drawing scores and selection works, and its conversion guard displays the expected toast.
- `node --check js/main.js` passes.

### Active
- Fix and retest the leaf stroke geometry failure: latest gameplay check raised `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'x')` in Three.js `generateSegment`, called by `geometryForStroke` at `js/main.js:56`; the leaf `TubeGeometry` uses `.85` tubular segments.
- Rerun drawing, conversion, weapon tuning/fire/reload, vehicle controls, and ink physics checks after fixing the geometry.
- Confirm the pointer-events fix is active in the browser, verify the favicon is served, and capture/inspect a fresh screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Change the invalid leaf `TubeGeometry` tubular-segment argument in `js/main.js:56` to a valid integer and rerun the gameplay check.
2. Verify pointer input produces strokes; test conversion, weapon behavior, vehicles, and ink physics; fix any issues found.
3. Check favicon serving and capture/inspect the latest screenshot.
4. Report assumptions and verification results; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `js/main.js`: Scene, gameplay, conversions, controls, and the leaf geometry failure at `geometryForStroke`.
- `styles.css`: HUD and brush-cursor pointer-events behavior.
- `index.html`: Game shell and favicon link.
- `favicon.svg`: Local favicon.
- `/tmp/opencode/gameplay-check.mjs`: CDP gameplay test.
- `/tmp/opencode/pointer-debug.mjs`: CDP pointer diagnostic.
- `/tmp/opencode/lineborn-latest.jpg`: Latest screenshot; refresh after fixes.

## Important Context
- Browser check URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8765/`; CDP endpoint: `http://127.0.0.1:9222`.
- The latest gameplay test showed Floatstone score `10`, selection “Floatstone stroke,” and its conversion guard toast; leaf drawing triggers the geometry exception.
- Latest gameplay check reported no missing network responses, but the screenshot and favicon still need rechecking after the fix.
